# `csharp_prefer_braces`

Add braces to unbraced control-flow bodies. IDE0011. Applied without a compilation.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `false` |  |
| `true` |  |
| `when_multiline` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Classify(int n)
    {
        if (n > 0)
        {
            return "positive";
        }
        else if (n < 0)
        {
            return "negative";
        }
        else
        {
            return "zero";
        }
    }
}
```

### `csharp_prefer_braces = false`

```ini
csharp_prefer_braces = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_prefer_braces = true`

```ini
csharp_prefer_braces = true
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_prefer_braces = when_multiline`

```ini
csharp_prefer_braces = when_multiline
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
